thread:
Rhea Gomez: FYI - FathomPay onboarding: we're seeing tail latency p95 ~2.4s on their dedicated pool during peak windows and cost units are ~2.1x forecast. Renewal in ~30 days. Proposing a proactive pilot: hybrid 4-bit/bfloat16 mixed-precision model swap + probabilistic tail routing to their dedicated us-east pool. Want eng + enablement + SRE to greenlight a 72h canary.

Diego Morales: can you share a perf link + representative trace?

Rhea Gomez: dash: https://redwood.app/d/fathompay/overview?panelId=tailing
trace: `req=fpay-77 seq=1..768 p50=110ms p95=2.4s model=redwood/merlin-13b`

Diego Morales: ok. idea: try "merlin-13b-mix4" (4-bit for attention + bfloat for dense) + enable prefix caching for repeated prompts. Should reduce GPU memory pressure and cut token-cost ~35%.

Rhea Gomez: dropping canary config below. cc @Priya for enablement schedule.

Diego Morales: ```
# canary: mix4 model + probabilistic routing
{"selector": "customer_id == \"fathompay\" && random() < 0.12",
 "model": "redwood/merlin-13b-mix4",
 "pool": "dedicated-fathompay-us-east",
 "prefix_cache": {"enabled": true, "ttl_minutes": 60},
 "max_qps": 250,
 "monitoring": {"slo_p95_ms": 1300, "compare_baseline": "redwood/merlin-13b"},
 "rollback_on": {"p95_increase_pct": 5, "error_rate_increase_pct": 0.25}
}
```

Priya Nair: I can run a 45-min enablement session: 10m architecture, 15m canary ops, 10m troubleshooting playbook, 10m renewal talking points. Slots Thurs/Fri next week.

Kait O'Neill: please surface estimated $$ delta for renewal doc. we'll need conservative and best-case savings.

Diego Morales: rough numbers: baseline unit ~$0.018/token-eq. mix4 path ~35% lower => ~$0.0117/token-eq. For their avg 2.8B tokens/mo that's ~ $29k/mo savings best-case. We'll validate after canary.

OpsBot: [alert] channel=fathompay_prod avg_seq_len up 16% in 24h, token_rate +12%. Created ticket CS-2108.

Rhea Gomez: linking CS-2108 so SRE/eng can correlate infra metrics. @Rowan SRE can you confirm pool headroom and schedule the reservation?

Rowan SRE: I can reserve a 2-GPU slot in dedicated-fathompay-us-east for a 72h canary. Need IAM list and expected peak rps. Also will attach temporary relabeling so we can split telemetry.

Diego Morales: peak rps ~320, steady ~140. IAM: rhea@redwood, diego@redwood, priya@redwood. I'll stage the config and smoke tests once slot is up.

Rhea Gomez: I'll draft a short note to the customer highlighting the pilot goals (latency tail smoothing + cost reduction) and the executive summary for renewal. Sharing for review before sending.

Kait O'Neill: include SLA language and how we'll measure success (p95 drop, cost delta, error parity). I'll add it to renewal playbook.

Rhea Gomez: thanks team — aiming to kick next Wednesday. Will update thread when reservation is done :slightly_smiling_face:
_description: Proactive optimization thread for FathomPay: propose mixed-precision (4-bit/bfloat16) model swap, prefix caching, and probabilistic routing to dedicated pool; coordinate eng, SRE, enablement; capture savings estimate and renewal playbook items
